# wsfed — WS-Federation

[All groups](README.md)

## wsfed metadata

Load WS-Federation metadata: the STS entity ID, passive requestor and STS endpoints, offered token types and signing certificates.

MCP tool: `wsfed_metadata`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--metadata` | string | URL, path or inline XML (e.g. https://adfs.example.com/FederationMetadata/2007-06/FederationMetadata.xml). **Required.** May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## wsfed login

Run WS-Federation passive sign-in (wa=wsignin1.0): send the browser to the STS, capture the token posted to a local wreply, and check wctx, the RSTR (lifetime, AppliesTo) and the SAML 1.1 or 2.0 token (signature, audience = wtrealm, validity). Blocks until the person signs in.

MCP tool: `wsfed_login`. Opens a browser and waits for a person.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--sts-url` | string | Passive requestor endpoint, overriding metadata (e.g. https://adfs.example.com/adfs/ls/). |
| `--wtrealm` | string | Realm (relying party identifier) registered at the STS. Default `urn:idpdbg`. |
| `--whr` | string | Home realm hint. |
| `--wauth` | string | Requested authentication method. |
| `--wfresh` | string | Maximum age of the sign-in in minutes (0 forces re-authentication). |
| `--reply-port` | int | Loopback port for wreply. Default `8767`. |
| `--reply-path` | string | Path for wreply. Default `/wsfed`. |
| `--metadata` | string | Federation metadata (URL, path or inline XML) for the STS signing certificates. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sts-cert` | string | STS signing certificate (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `120`. |
| `--open-browser` | bool | Open the system browser automatically. Default `true`. |
| `--wait` | int | Seconds to wait for the person to finish in the browser. Default `180`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## wsfed decode

Analyse a WS-Federation wresult (RequestSecurityTokenResponse) offline: lifetime, AppliesTo, and the SAML 1.1 or 2.0 token with its signature, audience and validity.

MCP tool: `wsfed_decode`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--wresult` | string | The wresult XML (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--wtrealm` | string | Expected realm (AppliesTo and audience). |
| `--metadata` | string | Federation metadata (URL, path or inline XML) for the STS signing certificates. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sts-cert` | string | STS signing certificate (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `120`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## wsfed signout_url

Build a WS-Federation sign-out URL (wa=wsignout1.0) with an optional wreply.

MCP tool: `wsfed_signout_url`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--sts-url` | string | Passive requestor endpoint. **Required.** |
| `--wtrealm` | string | Realm. Default `urn:idpdbg`. |
| `--wreply` | string | Where to return after sign-out. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
